lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَخْذُلْكُمْ is in the derivative form: يَخْذُلُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/ذ/ل   kh–dh–l straggler
; to stay behind, to be left behind; to fail to support; to weaken, to stay put.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
يَخْذُلُ yakhdhul; خَذُولٌ khadhūl and مَخْذُولٌ makhdhūl.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَخْذُلُ yakhdhul [imperf. of v. خَذَلَ khadhala, trans.] to let down, to deny one’s assistance to, to forsake

(3:160) إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلاَ غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ if God helps you, no one can overcome you; if He forsakes you, who is it that will help you other than [lit. after] Him?

entries.label: يَخْذُلُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يَخْذُلُ yakhdhul [imperf. of v. خَذَلَ khadhala, trans.] to let down, to deny one’s assistance to, to forsake

(3:160) إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلاَ غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ if God helps you, no one can overcome you; if He forsakes you, who is it that will help you other than [lit. after] Him?

entries.label: خَذُولٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
خَذُولٌ khadhūl [intens. act. part.] one given to letting others down, one characterised by forsaking friends, a deserter in the time of need

(25:29) وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلإِنْسَانِ خَذُولاً Satan has always let humankind down.

entries.label: مَخْذُولٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَخْذُولٌ makhdhūl [pass. part.] one who is let down, forsaken, deserted, abandoned

(17:22) ولاَ تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَخْذُولاً do not set up with God another god, lest you end up reproved and forsaken.
